seo.title: Antique Limestone Pavers & Stone Flooring
seo.description: Eco Outdoor provides the best in Antique Limestone pavers and flooring for your project. Find resources, request a sample or contact a rep today.

content.value: Our antique range of limestone flooring is sage with history and hand finished, meaning each stone is a unique work of art with its own patina and personality. Developed in close partnership with experts specialising in the restoration of French castles, our Antique flooring has been curated to deliver matchless character. You can lay it today, but it will look like it’s been there for a hundred years.
